story.iWant: all internal pages to use toubkal:// URLs instead of chrome:// URLs
story.soThat: Toubkal has a distinct brand identity
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Audit and catalog existing URL schemes (AC: 1, 3) - [ ] Search codebase for chrome:// URLs - [ ] Identify Brave-specific URLs (rewards, wallet, referrals) - [ ] Document URL scheme usage patterns
- [ ] Task 2: Implement toubkal:// URL scheme registration (AC: 1, 2) - [ ] Update Chromium URL scheme registration - [ ] Replace chrome:// with toubkal:// in C++ code - [ ] Update TypeScript/JavaScript references

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. All chrome:// URLs changed to toubkal:// throughout codebase 2. Internal pages accessible via toubkal:// (e.g., toubkal://settings, toubkal://newtab) 3. Brave-specific URLs rebranded (brave://rewards → removed, brave://wallet → removed) 4. Help documentation updated with new URL scheme 5. Error pages show toubkal:// URLs in examples 6. Chrome:// URLs auto-redirect to toubkal:// for backward compatibility 7. All internal navigation uses toubkal:// scheme consistently 8. URL scheme changes don't impact page load performance (>5% degradation)

constraint.description: Follow Chromium C++ style guide for URL scheme modifications
constraint.rationale: Maintains code consistency with Chromium codebase and reduces merge conflicts

constraint.description: Use TypeScript strict mode with no 'any' types
constraint.rationale: Code quality and maintainability requirements from CODING-RULES.md

constraint.description: Implement Result<T> pattern for error handling throughout
constraint.rationale: Consistent error handling approach defined in coding rules

constraint.description: Maintain backward compatibility with chrome:// URLs via auto-redirect
constraint.rationale: Ensures existing extensions and user bookmarks continue to work

constraint.description: Register toubkal:// scheme with operating systems (Windows/macOS/Linux)
constraint.rationale: Allows external applications to open toubkal:// URLs from email/chat clients

constraint.description: Implement CSP headers for all toubkal:// pages
constraint.rationale: Security requirement from ADR-007: UI Security to prevent XSS attacks

constraint.description: Performance impact must be <5% degradation in page load times
constraint.rationale: URL scheme changes should not negatively impact user experience

constraint.description: All toubkal:// pages must validate URL parameters and prevent injection attacks
constraint.rationale: Security hardening as specified in ADR-008

tests.standards: Use Google Test for C++ unit tests, Vitest for TypeScript tests, Playwright for E2E tests. Mock Chromium APIs and external dependencies. Achieve ≥80% test coverage. Use Result<T> pattern for error handling in tests.
tests.locations: src/toubkal/browser/url/*_unittest.cc for C++ unit tests, src/**/*.test.ts for TypeScript tests, src/components/routing/*.test.tsx for component tests, tests/e2e/url-scheme.spec.ts for E2E tests
tests.ideas: - Unit test URL scheme registration initializes correctly - Integration test chrome:// to toubkal:// redirects work end-to-end - E2E test all internal pages are accessible via toubkal:// scheme - Performance test URL redirects have <5ms latency - Security test invalid toubkal:// URLs are rejected - Cross-platform test URL scheme registration works on Windows/macOS/Linux - Component test ToubkalRouter handles all URL schemes correctly - Error handling test malformed URLs return appropriate error responses
